nodes.description: address public owner; ownership state variable of Ownable, written in constructor, renounceOwnership and _transferOwnership, read by onlyOwner modifier.
mapping (bytes32 => bytes32) companyMap; stores companyId => merkleRoot, written by _createCompany/_updateCompany and deleted by _deleteCompany.
constructor() public of Ownable that sets the deployer as owner (owner = msg.sender).
renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner; emits OwnershipRenounced and sets owner = address(0).
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner; forwards the new owner to the internal _transferOwnership.
internal _transferOwnership(address _newOwner); requires non-zero address, emits OwnershipTransferred and writes owner = _newOwner.
_createCompany(bytes32 companyId, bytes32 merkleRoot) public onlyOwner; writes companyMap[companyId] = merkleRoot and emits NewCompany.
_createCompanies(bytes32[] companyIds, bytes32[] merkleRoots) public onlyOwner; length-checked loop that calls _createCompany for each index.
getCompany(bytes32 companyId) public view returns (bytes32); reads companyMap[companyId].
_updateCompany(bytes32 companyId, bytes32 merkleRoot) public onlyOwner; overwrites companyMap[companyId] and emits ChangeCompany.
_updateCompanies(bytes32[] companyIds, bytes32[] merkleRoots) public onlyOwner; length-checked loop that calls _updateCompany for each index.
_deleteCompany(bytes32 companyId) public onlyOwner; deletes companyMap[companyId] and emits DeleteCompany.
msg.sender; used as the initial owner in the constructor and as the authorization subject of the onlyOwner modifier on all privileged functions.

Privileged state write owner = _newOwner inside _transferOwnership that hands over contract ownership.
State write owner = address(0) inside renounceOwnership that permanently removes the owner.
